hero.title: Frontend Developer
hero.bio: Building web applications driven by curiosity and the need to create things that are genuinely useful. I try to help whenever I can — in code and outside of it.

projects.heading: Projects
projects.subheading: Things I've worked on, both in and out of working hours.

items.name: Gamification programs
items.description: Frontend for several gamification platforms for large consumer brands, plus the company-wide dashboard. Built with Angular, focused on complex forms and integrations across multiple microsites.

items.name: AI-powered invoice digitization
items.description: A system where users upload a photo of a receipt; the Veryfi Lens API extracts the line items, which are then automatically logged as purchases through the Superlikers API. NestJS backend, Vite frontend.

items.name: fin
items.description: A personal app for managing my own finances. It came out of a real need and I still use it every day.

items.name: Spotify App
items.description: A web client consuming the Spotify API to explore artists, albums and playlists.

challenges.heading: Code challenges
challenges.description: Frontend Mentor exercises to practice fundamentals: layout, accessibility and state across different frameworks.

contact.heading: Let's work together
contact.description: I always try to help however I can. If you have something in mind, reach out.
